19.speaker: Narrator

25.speaker: Narrator

143.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
143.text: "Your Majesty, I've given my blood, my years, and my loyalty to Rizia -- to preserve the very kingdom you now accuse me of betraying."

144.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
144.text: "I have sacrificed more than most, and yet you demand that I surrender the very legacy I've fought to protect."

159.speaker: Titus Gordion

278.speaker: Hugo Toras
278.text: "Don't be a fool, General. You know there's only one choice to make here."
278.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Lucita"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Carlos"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Lucita"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Carlos"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn09_TalkWithTitus_InformHugoOfPlan"] == true)

282.speaker: Hugo Toras
282.text: "Pity it had to come to this."

290.speaker: Narrator
290.text: Hugo’s gaze lingered on Lucita's body, as if struggling to process what had happened.
290.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn09_TalkWithTitus_InformHugoOfPlan"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Taddeus_Executed"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Taddeus_Executed"] == true) == false)

294.speaker: Hugo Toras
294.text: "Your Majesty... I must admit, I never thought you'd take it this far."

298.speaker: Narrator
298.text: Hugo stepped near me, leaning in to whisper.

299.speaker: Player_Romus
299.text: "Perhaps you underestimated my resolve, Uncle. A mistake, I trust, you won't make again."

300.speaker: Player_Romus
300.text: "If you lack the stomach for hard decisions, perhaps it’s best you remain silent."

301.speaker: Player_Romus
301.text: "You may not see it now, but this will secure the future of the kingdom, Hugo."

302.speaker: Hugo Toras
302.text: "For all our sakes, I hope you're right."

303.speaker: Hugo Toras
303.text: "No, Your Majesty. Your resolve is clearer than ever."

304.speaker: Narrator
304.text: Hugo lowered his gaze, offering no reply.

308.speaker: Hugo Toras
308.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn09_TalkWithTitus_InformHugoOfPlan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Target_StrikeHouseToras"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ViolentAction_Deploy_WruhecsGuardians"] == true) == false)

312.speaker: Hugo Toras
312.text: "Well, that was less troublesome than I anticipated."

313.speaker: Player_Romus
313.text: "Sometimes things fall into place when you have the proper leverage."

314.speaker: Player_Romus
314.text: "I’m sure it was, Uncle. But let’s not get ahead of ourselves."

315.speaker: Player_Romus
315.text: "A reminder that the simplest approach can often be the most effective."

317.speaker: Hugo Toras
317.text: "True enough, Your Majesty. Leverage is everything."

321.speaker: Lucita Azaro
321.text: "Let go of me! You have no idea what you've done! This betrayal will haunt you!"

322.speaker: Narrator
322.text: Her screams continued to echo as she was dragged out of the room.

326.speaker: Narrator
326.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Lucita"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Carlos"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Lucita"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn09_TalkWithTitus_InformHugoOfPlan"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ForcedSignature"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Taddeus_Executed"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Carlos"] == true)

328.speaker: Narrator
328.text: Titus looked at me for a signal.

333.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
333.text: Gesture at Titus to pass the pen.

337.speaker: Hugo Toras
337.text: "Don’t. Think of what will happen if you refuse. This is the only way."

338.speaker: Narrator
338.text: Lucita glared at me, her gaze a mix of rage and anguish, readying to lash out. Hugo grabbed her arm, pulling her back.
338.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Lucita"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Carlos"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Lucita"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn09_TalkWithTitus_InformHugoOfPlan"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ForcedSignature"] == true)

339.speaker: Player_Romus
339.text: "I'd heed my uncle's warning if I were you."

342.speaker: Narrator
342.text: It took less than a heartbeat to realize that I was her intended target.

344.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
344.text: "Damn you, Romus Toras. You are a traitor to Rizia."

348.speaker: Player_Romus
348.text: "I can't let you go after you told me that now, can I?"

353.speaker: Player_Romus
353.text: "It makes my eyes tear up to see Housea Sazon and Azaro hand in hand."

355.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
355.text: "Damn you, Romus Toras. You are nothing but one man -- one tiny little man."

356.speaker: Player_Romus
356.text: "Alright. That was the last straw, General. Let this be a message to you both..."

357.speaker: Player_Romus
357.text: "Don't waste your words, General. It's over."

368.speaker: Player_Romus
368.text: "Your father already signed the documents. You'd better respect the law now."

372.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
372.text: "I have no choice but to respect this decree, Your Majesty."

373.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
373.text: "I swear my undying allegiance to you."

378.speaker: Narrator
378.text: Titus signaled to Sevrio, who took hold of Taddeus' wheelchair before passing him off to his Guardians waiting at the far end of the room.

382.speaker: Narrator
382.text: I nodded to Titus, who signaled to our armed visitors.

383.speaker: Narrator
383.text: I nodded to Titus, who signaled to Sevrio.

384.speaker: Narrator
384.text: Without missing a beat, two Wruhec's Guardians pushed Taddeus' wheelchair to the desk and pressed a pen firmly into his grip.

388.speaker: Narrator
388.text: I nodded to Titus, who signaled to our armed visitors.

389.speaker: Narrator
389.text: I nodded to Titus, who signaled to Sevrio.

393.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
393.text: "May he find redemption in the afterlife."

394.speaker: Narrator
394.text: The knife flew past me, embedding itself in the head of a wall-mounted animal above my shoulder. One of the guards pulled it out and handed it to me.

406.speaker: Narrator
406.text: After a moment, Lucita took a deep breath, calming herself down.

424.speaker: Lucita Azaro
424.text: "So it was all a lie? You gained my trust -- my love -- just so you could destroy my family?"

426.speaker: Narrator
426.text: In a flash, her hand moved to her side and pulled out the hidden knife she always carried. She drew her arm back.

428.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
428.text: "Lucita! Preserve the family honor at all costs!"

429.speaker: Narrator
429.text: Too shaken to respond, his daughter simply stared as he was wheeled out of the room.

430.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
430.text: "Carlos! Preserve the family honor at all costs!"

431.speaker: Narrator
431.text: His cousin looked away as he was wheeled out of the room.

433.speaker: Lucita Azaro
433.text: "No! The Queen of Rizia will not stand for such humiliation!"

437.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
437.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Carlos"] == false  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == true)

438.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
438.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Carlos"] == false  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == true)) == false

439.speaker: Narrator
439.text: With no signature left to gather, I took the pen and, in a single fluid stroke, transferred all Azaro property to the state.

440.speaker: Player_Romus
440.text: "Titus, I see no choice but for you to finish the job. Make it painless."
